exposure: Newborns with APGAR score <7 at 1st and 5th minute (cases)
Newborns with APGAR score ≥7 at 1st and 5th minute (controls)
cohort: Newborns delivered in public hospitals of West Shoa Zone, central Ethiopia
finding: Prolonged labor, breech presentation, caesarean section delivery, vaginal assisted delivery, not using partograph, and low birth weight were significantly associated with higher odds of birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery and vaginal assisted delivery were significantly associated with higher odds of birth asphyxia.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was a significant determinant of birth asphyxia.
